He was being stealthy about it, carrying it alongside his body in such a way as to hide it from the caretaker of the preserve, who we passed on the way out, so he knew it wasn't something he should do openly. I told him that it was a preserve, and that he should be taking nothing out of it. He claimed he "wanted to study it." (No, he's not a geologist.) I get that it's just a rock, but it is part of the ecosystem, and it should be there for others to enjoy. It belongs at the preserve. Am I wrong for being irritated that he took it?
